asset_type: Centrifugal Circulation Pump (KSB Calio Syn Series)
failure_modes: Bearing Failure due to Mechanical Wear or Cavitation Erosion
Motor Winding Insulation Breakdown due to Thermal Overload
Impeller Degradation due to Hydraulic Stress or Flow Imbalance

criteria.name: Maintenance & Inspection History
criteria.description: Manually assessed score reflecting the recency, completeness, and quality of preventive maintenance and inspection records for this pump.
criteria.ui_label: Maintenance History Risk Score (1=Excellent/Recent PM Completed, 10=No Record/Overdue)

criteria.name: Bearing & Mechanical Condition (Vibration)
criteria.description: Assesses mechanical degradation and bearing wear risk using Vibration_RMS, which is a direct indicator of rotor imbalance, misalignment, and cavitation erosion in centrifugal pumps.

penalties.description: Elevated bearing temperature co-occurring with high vibration accelerates bearing failure progression and lubrication breakdown

criteria.name: Motor Thermal Stress
criteria.description: Evaluates thermal overload risk to the motor using Motor_Current_A as a proxy for winding heat generation, where sustained high current accelerates insulation degradation.

penalties.description: High bearing temperature alongside elevated motor current indicates combined thermal stress accelerating motor winding insulation breakdown

criteria.name: Hydraulic Performance & Flow Integrity
criteria.description: Evaluates impeller degradation and hydraulic efficiency loss by assessing deviations in Flow_Rate_LPS from expected operating range, where low flow indicates blockage, wear, or cavitation.

penalties.description: Low discharge pressure combined with low flow rate indicates significant hydraulic degradation and elevated impeller or seal failure risk

criteria.name: Composite Health Index Degradation
criteria.description: Monitors the UAHI_Score as an aggregated asset health indicator, where declining scores reflect cumulative degradation across multiple failure modes in the pump.

penalties.description: High CI_Score alongside elevated UAHI_Score indicates confirmed active fault propagation amplifying overall failure risk

criteria.name: Alert Accumulation & Anomaly Frequency
criteria.description: Quantifies the frequency of active alert conditions using Alert_Hours, where sustained or increasing alert hours indicate progressive degradation requiring urgent intervention.

penalties.description: Elevated PAI_Score during high alert hours confirms performance anomaly acceleration and raises the probability of imminent failure

criteria.name: Operational Criticality & Redundancy
criteria.description: Manually assessed score reflecting the operational criticality of this pump, the consequence of its failure on the system, and whether a standby unit is available.
criteria.ui_label: Asset Criticality Score (1=Low Impact/Standby Available, 10=Critical Process/No Redundancy)
